prompts: Inside a containerised sovereign AI node in rural Kenya, in daily operation: two young Kenyan operators (a woman and a man in their twenties) in plain Gulf Blue (#1E3A5F) polo shirts and sand-coloured lanyards sit side by side at a compact operations desk at the end of a server aisle; the woman rests one hand on a mouse and the man rests both hands on a keyboard with clearly separated keys; two wall-mounted monitors above the desk and one open laptop on the desk face the camera, and every one of those screens is a chroma-key green rectangle. Black server racks with small green and amber status lights and real, slightly untidy cabling recede on the right; daylight from a small side window mixes with cool ceiling light. Calm, competent, everyday atmosphere. Seated eye-level camera from behind and slightly beside the operators so the screens face the camera. Photojournalistic documentary photograph that looks like a real press photo from a development-agency field report: shot on a Leica M11 with a 35mm Summilux at f/2.8, available natural light only, ISO 1600 with visible fine luminance grain, true skin texture with visible pores and small natural imperfections, flyaway hair, real fabric wrinkles, lived-in surfaces with scuffs and dust, slightly imperfect handheld framing; warm-neutral colour grade (cream, sand, parchment) with one deep Gulf Blue (#1E3A5F) element anchoring the frame. Hands: few hands visible, every hand relaxed and anatomically correct with five fingers, either resting flat on a surface or holding an object with a simple firm grip; no clapping, no interlaced fingers, no complex gestures. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos, signage, UI or writing anywhere. Every screen and every blank sign/certificate/cover surface described is a flat, evenly lit, solid chroma-key green (#00B140) rectangle with crisp straight edges and square corners, matte, no reflections, no green light spill. No robots, no holograms, no glowing brains, no neon, no sci-fi effects, no stock-photo gloss, no CGI smoothness. Landscape 3:2.

A government primary school classroom in a small town in Uttar Pradesh, India: pale green and cream painted walls with peeling patches, a ceiling fan, a blackboard with simple chalk drawings of circles divided into quarters (no writing), worn wooden benches, afternoon sun through window bars. On the teacher's wooden table stands one all-in-one AI desktop PC facing the camera at a slight three-quarter angle: a slim matte Gulf Blue (#1E3A5F) chassis with a broad flat bottom bezel; a chroma-key green rectangle is centred on the bottom bezel (about a quarter of the screen width, where a badge would be) and the monitor screen itself is a chroma-key green rectangle; a separate full-size keyboard with clearly separated keys and a mouse lie in front of it. An Indian woman teacher in a simple cotton sari stands beside the PC and points at the screen with her index finger; four schoolchildren aged 9 to 11 in light blue and white government school uniforms sit on a bench in front of the table, watching the screen, their hands resting on their knees or on the table; one child rests a hand on the mouse. Camera behind and slightly to the side of the children at their eye level so the screen and bezel face the camera. Kenyan smallholder farmland in the central highlands in soft late-afternoon light: uneven rows of young maize with a few yellowing leaves, red-earth paths, a scattered acacia, a few clouds. In the middle distance on the right stands one sovereign data-centre node: a single 40-foot shipping container painted matte Gulf Blue (#1E3A5F) on a concrete plinth, with a white steel door and ventilation louvres, under a simple raised steel frame carrying parallel rows of solar panels; on the long side of the container facing the camera is a large flat chroma-key green rectangular panel. Behind the container, clearly visible, are a small single-storey white rural health clinic with a veranda and a primary school with a corrugated metal roof. In the foreground on the left, a Kenyan woman smallholder farmer in her forties wearing a patterned headwrap and a worn work jacket stands at the edge of the maize, holding a smartphone in front of her chest with both hands in a simple firm grip, listening to it on speaker, the phone screen angled toward the camera and showing a chroma-key green rectangle. Standing eye-level camera; the farmer sharp on the left third, the node softly in focus.
